entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have this... uh... VeloBand Pulse thing? I need to return it. I'm just not sure how.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh. I guess it's a preference? I don't know. It works, I think, but I'm just overwhelmed by all the data and the app. I thought it would be simpler. I don't really understand it. Can't you just help me? I'd just like to send it back.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order information and check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, I have your order here. It looks like it was delivered about 25 days ago. Let me just check the policy on that item...
Okay, yes. According to our system, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you.
Oh! Really? That's... that's a relief. I was so worried it would be a problem. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a prepaid return label and instructions to the email address on your account. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That's wonderful. Thank you, Diana. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
